questions.q_en: In a queue, Hema is standing 22nd from the starting end. Twelve girls are standing between Hema and Leena. If only five girls are standing behind Leena, then how many girls are standing in a queue?
questions.solution_en:
Hema is standing 22nd from the starting end.

Twelve girls are standing between Hema and Leena.

Only five girls are standing behind Leena.

Thus, the sequence will be:

21 girls
Hema
12 girls
Leena
5 girls

Thus, total number of girls in a queue = 21+Hema+12+Leena+5= 40 girls.

questions.q_en:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All Cream is Lotion

No Lotion is Oil

Few Oil is Balm

Conclusions:

I: No Cream is Oil

II: Some Balm is not Lotion

III: Some Cream being Balm is a possibility
options_en: All I, II and III follow
questions.solution_en:
Statements:

All Cream is Lotion

No Lotion is Oil

Few Oil is Balm

No Cream is Oil: All Cream is Lotion. No Lotion is Oil. Thus, No Cream is Oil. So, conclusion I is true.

Some Balm is not Lotion: No Lotion is Oil. Few Oil is Balm. The Balm which is Oil is not Lotion. So, conclusion II is true.

Some Cream being Balm is a possibility: As there is no direct relation between Cream and Balm. Thus, there is a possibility of some Cream being Balm. So, conclusion III is true.

Hence, All conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.q_en:
In the sanctioned layout plan, Plot 1 is 20m to the west of Plot 2. Plot 3 is 25m to the south of Plot 1. Plot 4 is 30m to the east of Plot 2 and Plot 5 is 50m to the south of Plot 3.

The distance between Plot 1 and Plot 4 is _____ than the distance between Plot 1 and Plot 5.
questions.solution_en:
Plot 1 is 20m to the west of Plot 2. Plot 4 is 30m to the east of Plot 2

Plot 3 is 25m to the south of Plot 1. Plot 5 is 50m to the south of Plot 3.

The distance between Plot 1 and Plot 4 = 20 + 30 = 50

The distance between Plot 1 and Plot 5 = 25 + 50 = 75

So, difference = 75 - 50 = 25.

Thus, the distance between Plot 1 and Plot 4 is 25m less than the distance between Plot 1 and Plot 5.
